verdict.rationale: cubic documents an Analytics API, but it only exposes PR-level data such as issues flagged and fixed (cubic-docs-20), so it reads data rather than driving the product. Programmatic control is instead offered through an official MCP server that can request PR reviews, triage scan issues and manage seats (cubic-docs-15, cubic-docs-3, cubic-probe-3), and through a CLI (cubic-docs-31, cubic-probe-4). No OpenAPI spec was found at any probed path (cubic-probe-2). Missing for 10: a documented general-purpose public API for triggering reviews and managing configuration, a published OpenAPI/reference spec, and independent or hands-on corroboration of API usage.
